will also get DE scores for all the genes.

```{r}
nodes <- mutate(
    nodes,
    lfc_ctx_str = log2(
        rna_by_ge_rgnt_comp_cpm[name, "MGE_CTX_GABA"] /
            rna_by_ge_rgnt_comp_cpm[name, "MGE_STR_GABA"]
    ),
    TF = name %in% all_tfs
)
```

```{r}
g <- graph_from_data_frame(d = edges, directed = TRUE, vertices = nodes)
# V(g)$betweenness <- betweenness(g, directed = TRUE, normalized = TRUE)
V(g)$lfc_ctx_str <- nodes$lfc_ctx_str
E(g)$dir <- edges$dir

p <- ggraph(g, layout = "fr") +
    geom_edge_link(
        aes(color = dir),
        end_cap   = circle(0.75, "mm"),
        start_cap = circle(0.5, "mm"),
        arrow     = arrow(length = unit(1, "mm"), type = "closed"),
        edge_width = 0.25,
        show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_node_point(
        aes(shape = TF, color = lfc_ctx_str),
        # shape = 21, 
        stroke = 0.25,
        show.legend = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_node_text(
        aes(label = name),
        repel     = TRUE, 
        size      = 2, 
        vjust     = 0.5,
        family    = "ArialMT"
    ) +
    scale_color_gradient2(
        name = "log2FoldChange CTX vs. STR",
        low  = "blue", mid = "#EEEEEE", high = "red", # match ComplexHeatmap
        midpoint = 0,
        # limits = c(-9, 3), # the real limits...
        limits = c(-4, 4),
        oob = scales::squish
        # limits = c(
        #     min(V(g)$score, na.rm = TRUE),
        #     max(V(g)$score, na.rm = TRUE)
        # )
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
        name = "Betweenness", range = c(1, 3)
    ) +
    scale_edge_color_manual(
        values = c("+" = "black", "-" = "#E60000"),
        name = "Regulation"
    ) +
    guides(
        edge_color = guide_legend(order = 1),
        size       = guide_legend(order = 2),
        fill       = guide_colorbar(order = 3)
    ) +
    # theme_graph(base_family = "sans") +
    theme_md_classic() +
    theme(
        legend.position = "right",
        axis.line  = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.text  = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank()
    ) 

p

ggsave(
    file.path(pdir_str_ctx, paste0("selected_tfs_genes_network_ctx_vs_str_lfc.pdf")),
    p,
    width = 120, height = 60, units = "mm"
)
```

#### TF vs. Regulon compare (PV & SST)

PVALB:

```{r}
lapply(clusts_for_str_ctx_final, function(x) geneAUC_neur_by_cl_z[, x, drop=FALSE]) %>% 
    lapply(rowMeans) %>% 
    do.call(cbind, .) %>%
    .[, c("PVALB_STR", "PVALB_CTX")] %>% 
    apply(1, function(x) x[2] - x[1]) %>%  # CTX - STR
    .[sub(".*\\/", "", names(.)) != "-"] %>% # require positive peak-to-gene relationship
    split(., sub("_.*", "", names(.))) %>%  # split by TF
    lapply(function(x) x[which.max(abs(x))]) %>% # max diff for TF
    unname %>% 
    unlist %>% 
    (function(x) data.frame(
        regulon = names(x),
        regulon_diff = unname(x)
    )) %>% 
    mutate(
        TF = sub("_.*", "", regulon)
    ) %>% 
    left_join(
        {
            lapply(clusts_for_str_ctx_final, function(x) rna_by_cl_cpm[, x, drop=FALSE]) %>% 
                lapply(rowMeans) %>% 
                do.call(cbind, .) %>% 
                .[, c("PVALB_STR", "PVALB_CTX")] %>% 
                (function(x) data.frame(
                    TF_baseMean = rowMeans(x),
                    TF_log2FoldChange = apply(x, 1, function(x) log2(x[2] / x[1]))
                )) %>% 
                rownames_to_column("TF")
        },
        by = "TF"
    ) -> mge_pvalb_ctx_v_str_tfs_regulons
    
```

#### Pick new candidate TFs

```{r}
de_res_str_ctx %>% 
    lapply(. %>% .[all_tfs, ]) %>% 
    # [!] Require mean exp >10 CPM, and LFC>2
    lapply(filter, baseMean > 10, abs(log2FoldChange) > 2) %>% 
    lapply(mutate, region = ifelse(log2FoldChange > 0, "CTX", "STR")) %>% 
    lapply(function(x) split(rownames(x), x$region)) %>% 
    unlist(FALSE) %>% 
    setNames(., sub("\\.", "_", names(.))) ->
    cands_str_v_ctx_new
```

#### Take co-enriched regulon genes

Or co-depleted if a repressive regulon.

Here, will demand logical enrichment (or depletion if repressive) for the genes
in the regulon in question. And will put a LFC threshold in there...

```{r}
cands_str_v_ctx_new %>% 
    lapply(function(tf) filter(bind_rows(ereg_neur_dir, ereg_neur_ext), TF %in% tf)) %>% 
    # demand positive peak-to-gene relationship
    lapply(filter, sub(".*\\/", "", eRegulon_name) == "+") %>% 
    lapply(select, Gene, TF, eRegulon_name, regulation) %>% 
    lapply(function(x) split(x, list(x$TF, x$regulation), drop=TRUE)) %>% 
    unlist(FALSE) %>% # names like: "PVALB_CTX.PBX3.-1"   "PVALB_CTX.BCL11A.1"
    Map(function(x, full_nm) {
        nm_split <- strsplit(full_nm, "\\.")[[1]]
        nm  <- nm_split[1] # like "PVALB_CTX"
        tf  <- nm_split[2]
        dir <- nm_split[3] # "1" or "-1" for activation/repression
        
        subtype <- sub("_.*", "", nm) # PVALB or SST
        region  <- sub(".*_", "", nm) # STR or CTX
        
        genes <- unique(x$Gene)
        dfr <- de_res_str_ctx[[subtype]][genes, ] 
        
        # LFC is positive for CTX enr; dir = "-1" for repressive regulon
        sign_keep <- ifelse(
            region == "CTX",
            ifelse(dir == "1",  1, -1),
            ifelse(dir == "1", -1,  1)
        )
        
        rownames(filter(
            dfr, 
            sign(log2FoldChange) == sign_keep, 
            abs(log2FoldChange) > 1
        ))
    }, ., names(.)) ->
    cands_str_v_ctx_coenr_regulon_genes

# > lengths(cands_str_v_ctx_coenr_regulon_genes)
# PVALB_CTX.PBX3.-1  PVALB_CTX.BCL11A.1    PVALB_CTX.ETV6.1   PVALB_CTX.MEF2C.1    PVALB_CTX.PBX1.1 
#                 5                  20                   2                   7                  70 
#  PVALB_CTX.PBX3.1  PVALB_CTX.POU6F2.1   PVALB_CTX.SATB1.1    PVALB_CTX.SOX5.1 PVALB_CTX.ZNF385D.1 
#                26                  10                   4                  13                   7 
# PVALB_STR.NFIX.-1    PVALB_STR.ETV1.1    PVALB_STR.NFIB.1    PVALB_STR.NFIX.1  PVALB_STR.NKX2-1.1
```

```{r}
# take all TFs upstream of NFIB, NKX2-1, PBX3 (which are upstream of motogens)
edges <- bind_rows(ereg_neur_dir, ereg_neur_ext) %>%
    # require positive peak-to-gene relationship
    filter(sub(".*\\/", "", eRegulon_name) == "+") %>% 
    filter(Gene %in% c("NFIB", "NKX2-1", "PBX3")) %>%
    .$TF %>%
    unique %>% 
    union(c("NFIB", "NKX2-1", "PBX3")) %>% 
    (function(x) filter(bind_rows(ereg_neur_dir, ereg_neur_ext), TF %in% x)) %>% 
    # require positive peak-to-gene relationship
    filter(sub(".*\\/", "", eRegulon_name) == "+") %>% 
    filter((Gene %in% TF) | (Gene %in% c("SLIT3", "EFNB2", "SHH", "VEGFA", "SEMA3A"))) %>% 
    mutate(dir = ifelse(regulation == 1, "+", "-")) %>% 
    transmute(from = TF, to = Gene, dir) %>% 
    distinct()
```

```{r}
edges <- lhx6_net$edges
nodes <- lhx6_net$nodes

# z-score gene expression for node genes (for all clusters)
tmp <- scale_rows(rna_by_cl_cpm[nodes$TF, ])

# add TF expression
nodes <- lapply(clusts_for_str_ctx_final, function(x) tmp[, x, drop=FALSE]) %>% 
    lapply(rowMeans) %>% 
    do.call(cbind, .)  %>% 
    as.data.frame %>% 
    (function(x) setNames(x, paste0("exp_", names(x)))) %>% 
    cbind(nodes, .)

# z-score regulon usage for node genes (the TFs, NA for LHX6)
## it says the "max score" here, but i'm only using +/+ regulons, so it's just
## the score for that regulon
nodes <- sapply(clusts_for_str_ctx_final, function(x) {
    sapply(nodes$TF, function(tf) {
        if (!tf %in% ereg_neur_dir$TF)
            return(NA)
        # direct only
        ers  <- unique(subset(bind_rows(ereg_neur_dir_pp, ereg_neur_dir_mp), TF == tf)$eRegulon_name)
        erds <- sub(".*_(.)\\/.$", "\\1", ers)
        erm  <- rowMeans(geneAUC_neur_dir_pp_by_cl_z[ers, x, drop=FALSE])
        # invert for repressive (so low z-score means high "tf activity")
        scores <- ifelse(erds == "+", erm, -erm)
        # return max
        max(scores)
    })
}) %>% 
    as.data.frame %>% 
    (function(x) setNames(x, paste0("regulon_z_", names(x)))) %>% 
    cbind(nodes, .)
```

```{r}
plts_lhx6_net <- lapply(names(clusts_for_str_ctx_final), function(grp) {
    set.seed(1234)
    
    g <- graph_from_data_frame(
        d = transmute(edges, from = TF, to = Gene, dir),
        directed = TRUE,
        vertices = nodes
    )
    
    V(g)$TF_exp    <- nodes[[paste0("exp_", grp)]]
    V(g)$Regulon_z <- nodes[[paste0("regulon_z_", grp)]]
    
    E(g)$dir <- edges$dir
    
    
    # --- Draw with ggraph
    #
    # Plot normal edges and self-loops separately so can control the loops
    is_loop <- which(head_of(g, E(g)) == tail_of(g, E(g)))
    
    ggraph(g, layout = "fr") +
        # non-self edges
        geom_edge_link(
            aes(color = dir),
            end_cap   = circle(1.5, "mm"),
            start_cap = circle(1.5, "mm"),
            # arrow     = arrow(length = unit(3, "mm"), type = "closed"),
            arrow     = arrow(length = unit(1, "mm"), type = "closed"),
            # edge_width = 0.6,
            edge_width = 0.25,
            # alpha = 0.8,
            show.legend = TRUE
        ) +
        # self-loops (if any)
        # geom_edge_loop(
        #     aes(color = dir),
        #     # edge_width = 0.6,
        #     end_cap   = circle(0.75, "mm"),
        #     start_cap = circle(0.5, "mm"),
        #     edge_width = 0.25,
        #     # strength = 0.15,
        #     # arrow = arrow(length = unit(3, "mm"), type = "closed"),
        #     arrow = arrow(length = unit(1, "mm"), type = "closed"),
        #     show.legend = FALSE
        # ) +
        # nodes
        geom_node_point(
            aes(size = TF_exp, fill = Regulon_z),
            shape = 21, 
            # stroke = 0.4
            stroke = 0.25,
            show.legend = TRUE
        ) +
        geom_node_text(
            aes(label = name),
            repel     = TRUE, 
            size      = 2, 
            vjust     = 0.5,
            family    = "ArialMT"
        ) +
        scale_fill_gradient2(      ######## [!] Note I verified these limits were appropriate for my data
            name = "+/+ Regulon Activity\n(z-score, negated\nif repressive)",
            low  = "blue", mid = "#EEEEEE", high = "red", # match ComplexHeatmap
            midpoint = 0,
            limits = c(-4, 4),
            oob = scales::squish,
            # limits = c(
            #     min(V(g)$score, na.rm = TRUE),
            #     max(V(g)$score, na.rm = TRUE)
            # )
        ) +
        scale_size_continuous(
            name = "Gene expression\n(z-score)", 
            range = c(0.25, 4),
            limits = c(-4, 4)
        ) +
        scale_edge_color_manual(
            values = c("+" = "black", "-" = "#E60000"),
            name = "Regulation"
        ) +
        # guides(
        #     edge_color = guide_legend(order = 1),
        #     size       = guide_legend(order = 2),
        #     fill       = guide_colorbar(order = 3)
        # ) +
        # theme_graph(base_family = "sans") +
        theme_md_classic() +
        theme(
            legend.position = "right",
            axis.line  = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks = element_blank(),
            axis.text  = element_blank(),
            axis.title = element_blank()
        ) + 
        labs(title = sub("_", " ", grp))
})
```

Note that the subset I did earlier (for the 48 networks) requires a TF to both
be a target of other TFs in network, but also to target them as well. As such
it drops a couple TFs ("HOXA3" and "ZIC3") that were bottom-level targets but
in turn didn't target anything else in the network (and didn't self-regulate).

But I'm also dropping other regulons that don't have other targets in them,
in this case there are 14 more regulons for those TFs that just don't have the
other TFs as targets, so those regulons also get ignored.

In future, I think I should just take the TFs to make the network and ignore 
the regulons, if adding a regulon-related aesthetic just calculate it
downstream.


Ok, ZIC3 doesn't regulate any other TFs.

```{r}
group_use <- "MGE_STR_GABA" # just for scoring TF activity

ereg_active <- rbind(ereg_neur_dir, ereg_neur_ext) %>% 
    filter(
        Gene %in% nkx2_net$nodes$TF,
        TF %in% nkx2_net$nodes$TF
    ) %>% 
    .$eRegulon_name %>% 
    unique

# --- TF -> TF edges
edges <- bind_rows(ereg_neur_dir, ereg_neur_ext) %>% 
    filter(
        Gene %in% sub("_.*", "", ereg_active),
        TF %in% sub("_.*", "", ereg_active)
    ) %>% 
    mutate(dir = sub(".*_(.*)/.*", "\\1", eRegulon_name)) %>%  # "+" or "-"
    transmute(from = TF, to = Gene, dir) %>% 
    distinct()

# --- Summarize node activity for fill color
#
# for now, summarize TF activity across the 4 groups for all regulons (but this
# is just a sketch, I don't love this -> later will do these separately for
# each group so the weighting should look distinct when applicable)
#
# but basically, for each TF, take its max regulon score (as a proxy for its
# activity) [otherwise could use its expression...]
#
# then this also averages those maxes across the groups being used...
tf_activity <- geneAUC_neur_by_ge_rgnt_comp_z[, group_use, drop=FALSE] %>%
    as.data.frame %>%
    rownames_to_column("ereg") %>%
    mutate(TF = sub("_.*", "", ereg)) %>%
    group_by(TF) %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(group_use), ~max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(mean_z = rowMeans(across(all_of(group_use)), na.rm = TRUE))

# instead of doing activity, do TF expression
# tf_activity <- rna_by_ge_rgnt_comp_cpm_z[, group_use, drop=FALSE] %>% 
#     as.data.frame %>% 
#     rownames_to_column("TF") %>% 
#     filter(TF %in% c(edges$from, edges$to)) %>% 
#     group_by(TF) %>% 
#     mutate(mean_z = rowMeans(across(all_of(group_use)), na.rm = TRUE))

### example:
# > as.data.frame(head(tf_activity))
#       TF MGE_STR_GABA      mean_z
# 1  ACAA1  -0.08070435 -0.08070435
# 2   ADNP   0.41007952  0.41007952
# 3   AFF4  -0.35268395 -0.35268395
# 4 AHCTF1   0.47577668  0.47577668
# 5 ARID3A  -0.38154625 -0.38154625
# 6 ARID3B   0.92930915  0.92930915

nodes <- tibble(name = union(edges$from, edges$to)) %>% 
    left_join(tf_activity %>% select(TF, mean_z), by = c("name" = "TF"))

### example:
# > as.data.frame(head(nodes))
#     name     mean_z
# 1    ARX  2.6633132
# 2  BACH1  1.0780059
# 3 BCL11A  0.2888888
# 4   DLX1  0.3516292
# 5   DLX5  1.1018794
# 6   ELF2 -0.1300683

# --- graph object + centrality for node sizing
g <- graph_from_data_frame(d = edges, directed = TRUE, vertices = nodes)

# betweenness on the directed graph; use normalized for scale-friendliness
#
# "The vertex and edge betweenness are (roughly) defined by the number of 
# geodesics (shortest paths) going through a vertex or an edge."
V(g)$betweenness <- betweenness(g, directed = TRUE, normalized = TRUE)
V(g)$mean_z      <- nodes$mean_z

E(g)$dir <- edges$dir

# --- Draw with ggraph
#
# We'll plot normal edges + self-loops separately for good control.
is_loop <- which(head_of(g, E(g)) == tail_of(g, E(g)))

p <- ggraph(g, layout = "fr") +
    # non-self edges
    geom_edge_link(
        aes(color = dir),
        end_cap   = circle(0.75, "mm"),
        start_cap = circle(0.5, "mm"),
        # arrow     = arrow(length = unit(3, "mm"), type = "closed"),
        arrow     = arrow(length = unit(1, "mm"), type = "closed"),
        # edge_width = 0.6,
        edge_width = 0.25,
        # alpha = 0.8,
        show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    # self-loops (if any)
    # geom_edge_loop(
    #     aes(color = dir),
    #     # edge_width = 0.6,
    #     end_cap   = circle(0.75, "mm"),
    #     start_cap = circle(0.5, "mm"),
    #     edge_width = 0.25,
    #     # strength = 0.15,
    #     # arrow = arrow(length = unit(3, "mm"), type = "closed"),
    #     arrow = arrow(length = unit(1, "mm"), type = "closed"),
    #     show.legend = FALSE
    # ) +
    # nodes
    geom_node_point(
        aes(size = betweenness, fill = mean_z),
        shape = 21, 
        # stroke = 0.4
        stroke = 0.25,
        show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_node_text(
        aes(label = name),
        repel = TRUE, 
        size = 2, 
        vjust = 0.5,
        family = "ArialMT"
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
        name = "TF activity\n(max regulon z)",
        low = "blue", mid = "#EEEEEE", high = "red", # match ComplexHeatmap
        midpoint = 0, 
        limits = c(-4, 4),
        oob = scales::squish,
        # limits = c(
        #     min(V(g)$mean_z, na.rm = TRUE),
        #     max(V(g)$mean_z, na.rm = TRUE)
        # )
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
        name = "Betweenness", range = c(1, 3)
    ) +
    scale_edge_color_manual(
        values = c("+" = "black", "-" = "#E60000"),
        name = "Regulation"
    ) +
    # guides(
    #     edge_color = guide_legend(order = 1),
    #     size       = guide_legend(order = 2),
    #     fill       = guide_colorbar(order = 3)
    # ) +
    # theme_graph(base_family = "sans") +
    theme_md_classic() +
    theme(
        legend.position = "right",
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank()
    ) + 
    labs(title = paste(
        sub("_", " ", sub("_", "-", group_use))),
        collapse = ", "
    )

ggsave(
    file.path(pdir_str_ctx, paste0("nkx2_network_complete_with_activity_for", group_use, "2.pdf")),
    p,
    width = 60, height = 60, units = "mm"
)
```
